snippet.title: Necrofugitive - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Necrofugitive, a 2D stealth-action game about an evil shapeshifter on the run from justice, where an ancient mystery drives your every move. The Kickstarter launches on June 24th, 2025, with a release date to be confirmed. If you're keen to play, try the free demo and wishlist it on Steam! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Necrofugitive 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
